title: Robust Soft Skill Adaptation via Behavioral Localization in Tool-Using Agents
title_zh: 通过工具使用智能体中的行为定位实现稳健的软技能适配

paragraphs.en: Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems
paragraphs.zh: 面向鲁棒人工智能系统的自进化多样性驱动搜索

paragraphs.en: Text skills can extend the capabilities of tool-using agents, but long skill descriptions increase computational costs. Soft prompts provide a compact alternative, yet learning from entire successful trajectories may also introduce unnecessary behavioral changes. We find that the useful effect of a text skill is highly concentrated in a small subset of trajectory positions. Based on this observation, we propose Behavioral Localization, which compares the frozen agent with and without the text skill to identify positions where the skill both increases the likelihood of successful tokens and meaningfully changes the next token distribution. We use these localized positions to supervise a short soft prompt. Experiments on SpreadsheetBench with a frozen Qwen3.6-35B-A3B agent show that the top 10% of trajectory positions capture 96.12% of the total positive skill gain. In the shared prompt setting, selective supervision improves success from 30.36% with full trajectory to 36.79%. Under task-specific conditions, using the top 10% localized positions achieves 57.38%, outperforming both the full text skill and the on-policy OPCD baseline. These results show that a small set of behaviorally relevant trajectory positions can provide effective supervision of soft skills.
paragraphs.zh: 文本技能可以扩展使用工具的智能体的能力，但冗长的技能描述会增加计算成本。 软提示提供了一种紧凑的替代方案，然而从完整成功轨迹中学习也可能引入不必要的行为改变。 我们发现，文本技能的有用作用高度集中在轨迹位置的一个小子集上。 基于这一观察，我们提出行为定位方法，该方法通过比较冻结的智能体在有文本技能和没有文本技能两种情况下的表现，来识别那些既提高成功 token 的可能性、又实质性改变下一个 token 分布的位置。 我们利用这些定位出的位置来监督一个简短的软提示。 在 SpreadsheetBench 上使用冻结的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 智能体的实验表明，轨迹位置中最靠前的 10% 捕获了全部正技能增益的 96.12%。 在共享提示设置下，选择性监督将成功率从完整轨迹的 30.36% 提升到 36.79%。 在任务特定条件下，使用最靠前的 10% 定位位置达到了 57.38%，优于完整文本技能和在线 OPCD 基线。 这些结果表明，一小组行为相关的轨迹位置可以为软技能提供有效的监督。

paragraphs.en: As agents are increasingly deployed across diverse domains, tasks often differ substantially in their knowledge requirements, operational procedures, and behavioral patterns. These task-specific differences are difficult to address efficiently through repeated retraining or modification of the underlying agent Liu et al. (2024) . A flexible solution is to provide agents with task-specific guidance that helps them develop more effective task behaviors Li et al. (2026) .
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体在越来越多的不同领域中得到部署，任务在知识需求、操作流程和行为模式方面往往存在显著差异。 这些任务特定的差异很难通过反复的重新训练或修改底层智能体来高效地解决 Liu et al. (2024)。 一种灵活的解决方案是为智能体提供任务特定的指导，帮助其形成更有效的任务行为 Li et al. (2026)。

sents.en: As agents are increasingly deployed across diverse domains, tasks often differ substantially in their knowledge requirements, operational procedures, and behavioral patterns.
sents.zh: 随着智能体在越来越多的不同领域中得到部署，任务在知识需求、操作流程和行为模式方面往往存在显著差异。

sents.en: These task-specific differences are difficult to address efficiently through repeated retraining or modification of the underlying agent Liu et al. (2024) .
sents.zh: 这些任务特定的差异很难通过反复的重新训练或修改底层智能体来高效地解决 Liu et al. (2024)。

sents.en: A flexible solution is to provide agents with task-specific guidance that helps them develop more effective task behaviors Li et al. (2026) .
sents.zh: 一种灵活的解决方案是为智能体提供任务特定的指导，帮助其形成更有效的任务行为 Li et al. (2026)。

paragraphs.en: A direct approach to task adaptation is known as an agent skill, where natural language prompts are used to specify task goals, operational rules, and expected behaviors, allowing the model to perform new tasks without updating its parameters Anthropic (2025) . However, this approach often relies on lengthy and carefully designed prompts, and its effectiveness can be sensitive to wording and example selection. As tasks become more complex, the prompts typically grow longer, increasing both context usage and inference cost Mu et al. (2023) .
paragraphs.zh: 任务适配的一种直接方法被称为智能体技能（agent skill），即使用自然语言提示来指定任务目标、操作规则和预期行为，使模型无需更新参数即可执行新任务 Anthropic (2025) 。 然而，这种方法通常依赖于冗长且经过精心设计的提示，其效果可能对措辞和示例的选择十分敏感。 随着任务变得更加复杂，提示通常会变得更长，从而增加上下文占用和推理成本 Mu et al. (2023) 。

sents.en: A direct approach to task adaptation is known as an agent skill, where natural language prompts are used to specify task goals, operational rules, and expected behaviors, allowing the model to perform new tasks without updating its parameters Anthropic (2025) .
sents.zh: 任务适配的一种直接方法被称为智能体技能（agent skill），即使用自然语言提示来指定任务目标、操作规则和预期行为，使模型无需更新参数即可执行新任务 Anthropic (2025) 。

paragraphs.en: To obtain more compact and learnable skill representations, prior work has explored directly optimizing prompts in continuous representation spaces. Compared with natural language instructions, soft prompts typically require less storage and can support task adaptation by updating a small set of trainable prompt embeddings Tao et al. (2026) ; Lester et al. (2021) . However, these continuous vectors lack clear counterparts in natural language Deng et al. (2022) . As a result, while learning a target skill, a soft prompt can also introduce unexpected behavioral changes Ma et al. (2022) . For agents, because generation is sequential, even small shifts in early predictions can propagate and amplify over subsequent steps, leading to incorrect tool selection, malformed outputs, or task execution failures Bengio et al. (2015) ; Li et al. (2023) . Thus, acquiring new capabilities may come at the cost of degrading abilities that the base model already possesses Zhu et al. (2022) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了获得更紧凑、更易学习的技能表示，先前的工作探索了在连续表示空间中直接优化提示。 与自然语言指令相比，软提示通常需要更少的存储空间，并且可以通过更新一小组可训练的提示嵌入来支持任务适配 Tao et al. (2026) ; Lester et al. (2021) 。 然而，这些连续向量在自然语言中缺乏明确的对应物 Deng et al. (2022) 。 因此，在学习目标技能的同时，软提示也可能引入意想不到的行为变化 Ma et al. (2022) 。 对于智能体而言，由于生成是按顺序进行的，早期预测中即使是很小的偏移也会在后续步骤中传播和放大，导致错误的工具选择、格式错误的输出或任务执行失败 Bengio et al. (2015) ; Li et al. (2023) 。 因此，获得新能力可能以损害基础模型已有能力为代价 Zhu et al. (2022) 。

paragraphs.en: We find that the behavioral effect of a skill is highly concentrated in a small number of critical decision points, while much of the remaining trajectory is already correctly handled by the base agent. This suggests that robust soft skill adaptation should focus on which behaviors truly need to be learned. Based on this observation, we propose Behavioral Localization, which identifies the trajectory positions where a text skill meaningfully changes the predictions of base agent and selectively uses these positions to train a compact soft skill. At the same time, we constrain selected preservation positions toward the base distribution to reduce unnecessary behavioral drift.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，一项技能的行为效应高度集中在少数关键决策点上，而其余大部分轨迹已由基础智能体正确处理。 这表明，鲁棒的软技能适配应聚焦于哪些行为真正需要学习。 基于这一观察，我们提出行为定位（Behavioral Localization），它识别文本技能切实改变基础智能体预测的轨迹位置，并选择性地利用这些位置来训练一个紧凑的软技能。 同时，我们将选定的保留位置向基础分布约束，以减少不必要的行为漂移。

sents.en: We find that the behavioral effect of a skill is highly concentrated in a small number of critical decision points, while much of the remaining trajectory is already correctly handled by the base agent.
sents.zh: 我们发现，一项技能的行为效应高度集中在少数关键决策点上，而其余大部分轨迹已由基础智能体正确处理。

sents.en: This suggests that robust soft skill adaptation should focus on which behaviors truly need to be learned.
sents.zh: 这表明，鲁棒的软技能适配应聚焦于哪些行为真正需要学习。

sents.en: Based on this observation, we propose Behavioral Localization, which identifies the trajectory positions where a text skill meaningfully changes the predictions of base agent and selectively uses these positions to train a compact soft skill.
sents.zh: 基于这一观察，我们提出行为定位（Behavioral Localization），它识别文本技能切实改变基础智能体预测的轨迹位置，并选择性地利用这些位置来训练一个紧凑的软技能。

sents.en: At the same time, we constrain selected preservation positions toward the base distribution to reduce unnecessary behavioral drift.
sents.zh: 同时，我们将选定的保留位置向基础分布约束，以减少不必要的行为漂移。

paragraphs.en: First, through token-level distributional analysis, we find that skill induced behavioral changes are highly sparse.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，通过词元级分布分析，我们发现技能诱发的行为变化高度稀疏。

paragraphs.en: Second, we show that training a soft prompt using only selected positions by Behavioral Localization in the trajectory as supervision outperforms training on the full trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，我们证明，仅使用轨迹中由行为定位（Behavioral Localization）选定的位置作为监督来训练软提示（soft prompt），其效果优于在完整轨迹上进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Prompt learning provides a foundation for representing task-specific capabilities in continuous spaces. Prompt Tuning, Prefix-Tuning, and P-Tuning show that a frozen base model can be adapted by optimizing only a small set of continuous prompt embeddings Lester et al. (2021) ; Li and Liang (2021) ; Liu et al. (2022) . Later work explores how these representations can be reused. For example, SPoT transfers learned soft prompts from source tasks to similar target tasks Vu et al. (2022) . XPrompt finds that some prompt tokens can hurt downstream performance and removes these negative parts Ma et al. (2022) . These studies mainly focus on how soft prompts are parameterized and reused. Another line of work compresses long natural language contexts into compact latent representations. Gisting compresses long prompts into a small number of reusable gist tokens Mu et al. (2023) . ICAE encodes long contexts into a few memory slots that can directly condition a language model Ge et al. (2024) . These methods mainly aim to preserve the semantics of the original text after compression.
paragraphs.zh: 提示学习为在连续空间中表示任务特定能力提供了基础。 Prompt Tuning、Prefix-Tuning 和 P-Tuning 表明，仅通过优化一小部分连续提示嵌入，就能使冻结的基础模型得到适配 Lester et al. (2021)；Li and Liang (2021)；Liu et al. (2022)。 后续工作探讨了如何复用这些表示。 例如，SPoT 将从源任务学到的软提示迁移到类似的目标任务 Vu et al. (2022)。 XPrompt 发现某些提示词元会损害下游性能，并移除了这些负面部分 Ma et al. (2022)。 这些研究主要关注软提示的参数化与复用方式。 另一类工作将长自然语言上下文压缩为紧凑的潜在表示。 Gisting 将长提示压缩为少量可复用的要旨词元 Mu et al. (2023)。 ICAE 将长上下文编码为少量记忆槽，可直接用于调节语言模型 Ge et al. (2024)。 这些方法的主要目标是压缩后保留原文的语义。

sents.en: Prompt learning provides a foundation for representing task-specific capabilities in continuous spaces.
sents.zh: 提示学习为在连续空间中表示任务特定能力提供了基础。

sents.en: Prompt Tuning, Prefix-Tuning, and P-Tuning show that a frozen base model can be adapted by optimizing only a small set of continuous prompt embeddings Lester et al.
sents.zh: Prompt Tuning、Prefix-Tuning 和 P-Tuning 表明，仅通过优化一小部分连续提示嵌入，就能使冻结的基础模型得到适配 Lester et al.

sents.en: (2021) ; Li and Liang (2021) ; Liu et al. (2022) .
sents.zh: (2021)；Li and Liang (2021)；Liu et al. (2022)。

sents.en: Later work explores how these representations can be reused.
sents.zh: 后续工作探讨了如何复用这些表示。

sents.zh: XPrompt 发现某些提示词元会损害下游性能，并移除了这些负面部分 Ma et al. (2022)。

sents.en: These studies mainly focus on how soft prompts are parameterized and reused.
sents.zh: 这些研究主要关注软提示的参数化与复用方式。

sents.en: Another line of work compresses long natural language contexts into compact latent representations.
sents.zh: 另一类工作将长自然语言上下文压缩为紧凑的潜在表示。

sents.en: Gisting compresses long prompts into a small number of reusable gist tokens Mu et al. (2023) .
sents.zh: Gisting 将长提示压缩为少量可复用的要旨词元 Mu et al. (2023)。

sents.en: ICAE encodes long contexts into a few memory slots that can directly condition a language model Ge et al. (2024) .
sents.zh: ICAE 将长上下文编码为少量记忆槽，可直接用于调节语言模型 Ge et al. (2024)。

sents.zh: 这些方法的主要目标是压缩后保留原文的语义。

paragraphs.en: Agent skills differ from general text compression because their main purpose is to guide an agent’s behavior. Therefore, a compressed representation should preserve the behavioral effect introduced by the skill. Recent work has begun to reuse successful agent trajectories to compress textual skills offline. SoftSkill compresses a natural-language skill into a short continuous prefix while keeping the base model frozen Tao et al. (2026) . It trains the prefix by predicting the next tokens in successful trajectories. LatentSkill instead converts textual skills into task-specific LoRA adapters, moving reusable skill knowledge from the context space into the model’s weight space Yu et al. (2026) . These studies show that textual agent skills can be encoded as compact latent representations. However, they mainly focus on how a skill should be represented or stored. In contrast, we study which behavioral changes introduced by a skill should be used to learn such a representation.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体技能与一般文本压缩不同，因为其主要目的是引导智能体的行为。 因此，压缩后的表示应保留技能所引入的行为效果。 近期的工作已开始复用成功的智能体轨迹来离线压缩文本技能。 SoftSkill 将自然语言技能压缩为一段简短的连续前缀，同时保持基础模型冻结 Tao et al. (2026)。 它通过预测成功轨迹中的下一个词元来训练该前缀。 LatentSkill 则将文本技能转换为任务特定的 LoRA 适配器，把可复用的技能知识从上下文空间迁移到模型的权重空间 Yu et al. (2026)。 这些研究表明，文本形式的智能体技能可以被编码为紧凑的潜在表示。 然而，它们主要关注技能应如何表示或存储。 相比之下，我们研究应利用技能所引入的哪些行为变化来学习这种表示。

sents.en: Agent skills differ from general text compression because their main purpose is to guide an agent’s behavior.
sents.zh: 智能体技能与一般文本压缩不同，因为其主要目的是引导智能体的行为。

sents.en: Therefore, a compressed representation should preserve the behavioral effect introduced by the skill.
sents.zh: 因此，压缩后的表示应保留技能所引入的行为效果。

sents.en: It trains the prefix by predicting the next tokens in successful trajectories.
sents.zh: 它通过预测成功轨迹中的下一个词元来训练该前缀。

sents.zh: LatentSkill 则将文本技能转换为任务特定的 LoRA 适配器，把可复用的技能知识从上下文空间迁移到模型的权重空间 Yu et al. (2026)。

sents.en: These studies show that textual agent skills can be encoded as compact latent representations.
sents.zh: 这些研究表明，文本形式的智能体技能可以被编码为紧凑的潜在表示。

sents.en: However, they mainly focus on how a skill should be represented or stored.
sents.zh: 然而，它们主要关注技能应如何表示或存储。

sents.en: In contrast, we study which behavioral changes introduced by a skill should be used to learn such a representation.
sents.zh: 相比之下，我们研究应利用技能所引入的哪些行为变化来学习这种表示。

paragraphs.en: Let p θ p_{\theta} be a frozen agent and let S S denote a text skill shared by a family of tasks. paragraphs.en: We conduct our experiments on SpreadsheetBench Ma et al. (2024) . We use GPT-5.5 to generate the successful teacher trajectories. All experiments use Qwen3.6-35B-A3B as the frozen student model, with all parameters fixed during training. Each soft prompt has a length of 8 and is initialized using the embeddings of the first same tokens of the full text skill.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SpreadsheetBench Ma et al. (2024) 上进行实验。 我们使用 GPT-5.5 来生成成功的教师轨迹。 所有实验均使用 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 作为冻结的学生模型，训练期间其所有参数保持固定。 每个软提示的长度为 8，并使用全文技能的首个相同词元的嵌入进行初始化。

paragraphs.en: During evaluation, we use greedy decoding with a maximum of 4,096 token cost and set the execution timeout for each task to 600 seconds. A task is considered successful only if the generated output passes all SpreadsheetBench checks.

paragraphs.en: We use the Behavioral Locator to select key positions and optimize both a shared soft prompt across tasks and task-specific soft prompts for individual tasks. As shown in Figure 1 , the positive gain is highly concentrated in a small subset of trajectory positions. Selecting only 10% of the tokens captures 96.12% of the total positive Skill effect. This motivates us to use a sparse set of relevant tokens as supervision for soft skill learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用行为定位器来选择关键位置，并优化跨任务共享的软提示以及针对单个任务的任务专属软提示。 如图1所示，正向收益高度集中在轨迹位置的一个小子集中。 仅选择10%的词元就能捕获96.12%的总正向技能效应。 这促使我们使用一组稀疏的相关词元作为软技能学习的监督信号。

paragraphs.en: No Skill measures the capability of the base agent, while Text Skill represents the up bound by providing the full text skill. SoftSkill is the offline full-trajectory compression baseline. OPCD is an important on-policy distillation baseline that trains online rather than relying on fixed teacher trajectories. Our method instead relies on lower cost offline teacher trajectories. Under the shared prompt setting, our method improves over full-trajectory SoftSkill, although it remains below the on-policy OPCD baseline. More importantly, under task-specific condition, selecting the top 10% localized positions achieves 57.38%, outperforming both Text Skill and OPCD. These results support a small subset of token can provide sufficient supervision for learning effective soft prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 无 Skill 衡量基础智能体的能力，而 Text Skill 通过提供完整文本技能代表上界。 SoftSkill 是离线全轨迹压缩基线。 OPCD 是一个重要的在线策略蒸馏基线，它进行在线训练而不依赖固定的教师轨迹。 我们的方法则依赖成本更低的离线教师轨迹。 在共享提示设置下，我们的方法优于全轨迹 SoftSkill，但仍低于在线策略的 OPCD 基线。 更重要的是，在任务特定条件下，选择前 10% 的局部化位置达到了 57.38%，同时超过了 Text Skill 和 OPCD。 这些结果表明，一小部分 token 就足以为学习有效的软提示提供监督。
